== Biography ==
Jean was born about 1710. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1056|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Kilpatrick-1635|Janet Kilpatrick]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1056]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Jean’s 31 December 1710 Byres entry names Hugh Glasgow and Janet Patrick; the same named couple and Byres residence recur in the established Hugh household. No competing Hugh/Janet family is held.

The adult Hugh/Janet household is identified; Hugh’s own childhood and John/Agnes ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original p74 wording if resolving Patrick/Kilpatrick variants becomes necessary.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3625965&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Jean Glasgow, 31 Dec 1710, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3625965].
